create_eval_eval: create a new evaluation with data source config and testing criteria for LLM grading
list_evals_eval: list evaluations with pagination using limit, after, before, order, and order_by parameters
create_run_eval: create a new run for an evaluation with data source configuration for jsonl or completions
list_runs_eval: list all runs for an evaluation with pagination using limit, after, before, and order
update_eval_eval: update an evaluation name and metadata while filtering out internal LiteLLM keys
